name: tract_developer_aggregation_build
description: Aggregation and the Build failure paths, by hand from 4.3, 4.9.2, 4.13, 4.14 and 4.15. Residential developer, demand 10 (desired 10, desiredMax 15); two empty 1 x 1 lots 1 (0, 0) and 2 (1, 0), facing 0; one 2 x 1 configuration (family 600 = {0x300}, capacity 10). Existing listing: size differs for both lots (row 3 {5: 2}). Aggregation for lot 1: trial (a) at (0, 0) has rect -1..0 (outside the city: false, no histogram), trial (b) at x + 1 = (1, 0) has rect 0..1 x 0, both lots suitable and facing 0: legal (row 9 {27}), compatible: added. Lot 2: trial (a) at (1, 0) is the same rect: added; trial (b) at (2, 0) has no lot at (2, 0): false. Two candidates, both score r24(1 x newLot[0] = 1) = 1 (residential: no draw); the sort keeps the first. Build: PickBuilding (anchor test on rect (0, 0, 1, 0), R4 of 1, R5 of 1), Claim(10), PerformAggregation demolishes and deletes lots 1 and 2, CreateLotIfPossible(0, 0, 2, 1, facing 0), RedisplayTerrain(rect), StartConstruction(new lot, 101, 0x300, true); built 10 >= desired: outcomes [27]. Part 2, [quirk] of 4.15.1: the same with CreateLotIfPossible failing: Build returns 0 and the 10 claimed units are not released. A 0 neither stops the pass nor breaks the candidate loop (only 20, built >= desired and 27 do), so the second candidate is built too: its lot set still names lots 1 and 2 (the original holds references to them), which are demolished and deleted again, and the creation fails again: row 6 {0: 2} (the histogram is cleared per Grow), 20 units claimed and kept. Pass 2 finds no lot and an empty candidate list, so it pushes max(1, 0, ...) = 1 and stops: outcomes [0, 0, 1], built 0, used 20. Part 3: supply 5: Claim(10) fails -> 20 (row 6 {20: 2}); in the strict pass this does not stop the loop; the relaxed pass fails again and stops: outcomes [20, 20], the lots are untouched.
